name: ETVA
description: A benchmark and evaluation method for text-to-video alignment that uses fine-grained question generation and answering to assess semantic alignment between text prompts and generated videos, providing higher correlation with human judgment than existing metrics.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from 2025 that is not yet widely established, but it is positioned as a promising alternative to existing text-to-video alignment metrics.
notes: Includes a benchmark with 2k prompts and 12k atomic questions across 10 categories; uses a multi-agent system and multi-stage reasoning.
